sections.b: We deliver across San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley and San Jose. Enter your postcode at checkout to confirm coverage.
Choose express delivery in 45 minutes or book a two-hour slot up to seven days ahead. Slots can be changed until your order is packed.
Delivery is free on orders over $50. Orders below $50 have a flat $4.99 fee. There is no minimum order.
Chilled items are packed in insulated liners and stay cold for four hours. Add safe-place instructions at checkout.
If any product isn't fresh or up to standard, we'll refund it in full. You don't need to send it back.
Open My Orders, select the order and choose Report an issue. Add a photo if you can. Most requests are approved instantly.
Refunds go back to your original payment method in 3–5 working days, or instantly as Daily Basket credit.
If an item is missing, we'll refund it or deliver it free on your next order, whichever you prefer.
Every farm is certified organic and visited by our sourcing team before we list their produce.
Growers set their own prices and are paid within seven days. We don't ask for listing fees or promotional contributions.

sections.b: Your name, email, phone number, delivery addresses and order history. Payment details are handled by our payment provider and never stored on our servers.
To process and deliver orders, provide customer support, send order updates and, if you opt in, share offers and harvest notes.
We share only what is needed with delivery partners and payment processors. We never sell your personal data.
We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your basket, plus optional analytics cookies you can turn off in Settings.
Order records are kept for seven years for tax purposes. Other account data is deleted within 30 days of closing your account.
You can access, correct, export or delete your data at any time from your account, or by emailing privacy@dailybasket.example.
Daily Basket, 18 Meadow Row, San Francisco, CA 94110. Email privacy@dailybasket.example with any questions about this policy.
By creating an account or placing an order you agree to these terms. You must be 18 or older to place an order.
Prices include applicable taxes and are confirmed at checkout. Fresh items are priced by the listed weight and may vary slightly.
If an item is unavailable we may offer a similar substitute. You can reject any substitute at the door for a full refund.
We aim to deliver within the chosen slot. If we are late by more than 30 minutes, your delivery fee is refunded automatically.
You can cancel free of charge until your order is packed. After that, cancellation may not be possible.
Gift cards are valid for 24 months and cannot be exchanged for cash. Promo codes cannot be combined unless stated.
Our liability is limited to the value of your order, except where the law does not allow this limitation.
We may update these terms. Significant changes will be emailed to you at least 14 days before they take effect.
Returnable crates and home-compostable liners replace single-use plastic across every order.
Our vans are fully electric and routes are planned to minimise miles. Remaining emissions are offset through verified projects.
Unsold produce goes to local food banks each evening. Anything left is composted and returned to partner farms.
We publish an impact report every year with our packaging, emissions and waste figures.

FAQS: Most orders arrive within 45 minutes in San Francisco. You can also book a two-hour slot up to seven days ahead.
Yes. Every fresh product is certified organic and comes from a named grower within 80 miles of our depot.
Delivery is free on orders over $50. Below that, a flat $4.99 fee applies.
What if an item is damaged or missing?
Report it in your account within 48 hours and we'll refund or replace it on your next order.
Can I change my order after placing it?
You can add or remove items until your order is packed, usually 30 minutes before the delivery slot.
Yes. Leave crates at the door on your next delivery and the driver will collect them.
Which payment methods do you accept?
Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Daily Basket gift cards.
How do I become a grower?
Email growers@dailybasket.example with your farm details and certification. We visit every new supplier before listing their produce.
